  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)

    (arm-empty)

    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))

  ;; Action: stack a held block onto another clear block, respecting fragility
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)

  )
  ;; Action: unstack a clear block from another block

    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))

)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips) ; basic STRIPS
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)          ; block ?x is on block ?y
    (on-table ?x)       ; block ?x is on the table
    (clear ?x)          ; nothing on top of ?x
    (holding ?x)        ; robot arm holding ?x
    (arm-empty)         ; robot arm is empty
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))))
  ;; ACTION: put down a held block onto the table
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))))
  ;; ACTION: stack a held block onto a clear block
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))))
  ;; ACTION: unstack a clear block from another clear block
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))))
)
